Test your new ritualist skills on some easy targets.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Ritualist
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak with Professor Gai when you are ready to begin your test.
* Destroy the wild minions in the mausoleum. [5...0] minion[s] remaining.
* See Professor Gai for your reward.

===Early benefits===
*Professor Gai will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
**{{skill icon|Brutal Weapon}}
**{{skill icon|Union}}

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
When you talk to Professor Gai again, a level 3 Wild Minion will appear nearby for you to kill, another after the first dies, and so on until you have killed all 5.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
*{{x}} 3 (22) [[Wild Minion]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Professor Gai
''The onus is again upon the Ritualists to attend to the Necromancers' foul leavings. One of their number has lost control of an agglomeration of [[minion]]s, which are now loose in the [[Kaabo Cemetery|cemetary]] {{sic|cemetery}}. I want you to take care of this problem for us. It will prove useful in evaluating your abilities. I shall give you some skills that may prove useful in dealing with this task. Once you feel comfortable with how these skills work, speak with me again to begin your test.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I can handle a few minions.
| decline = I am not the Ritualist you are looking for.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Professor Gai
:''I hope you are ready, <Character name>, here they come!''

===Reward dialogue===
;Professor Gai
:''As I said, this was an excellent test of your Ritualist skills. Your training is progressing at a most accelerated rate.''

== Trivia ==
*The name of this quest is a reference to [[W:Girls Gone Wild|Girls Gone Wild]].
*The quote "I am not the Ritualist you are looking for." may be a refrence to the Star Wars episode 4 quote "these aren't the droids you're looking for."
